entries.note: Two arXiv papers extracted as abstract-level sources confirming QI stellarator bootstrap current is near-zero by design. entries.notes: No new open-access source found specifically addressing WCLL steam Rankine thermal efficiency for a stellarator. The HELIAS BoP paper (2019, HCPB configuration) and the Famà et al. power conversion paper (liquid metal wall, sCO2) are the closest available analogues but are paywalled and/or wrong configuration. The existing sources arxiv-1401-4232 (general fusion conversion) and helios-stellarator-comparison.md (40% for vanadium-alloy Helios) remain the best proxies.
